text: Added opt-in auto-commit in packages/engine/src/autocommit.ts. It is held in engine memory only, so it resets on restart. Enabling runs `git commit --only -- .yolo-twice` at once, then every 10 min when something changed. It skips during merges, rebases or a detached HEAD. Toggled from a header button or `yolo-twice autocommit on|off`, backed by GET/PUT /api/autocommit (1a719fa, tests pass). A stale engine hid the button until restarted. Added auto-reload: `hello` and a new `build` SSE event carry a build id, and `bun run dev` runs the engine under `bun --watch` plus `vite build --watch` (65a7fea). The header shows the next commit time (b1bc5d3). A slicing bug dropped AM/PM, fixed with locale formatting (c238968).
